DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21215-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21215-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 入金をご希望ですね。通帳をお持ちでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21215-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: You would like to make a deposit. Do you have your passbook?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21215-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21215-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。旅行用に残していた現金を、自分の口座へ入れたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21215-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 旅行用現金を自己口座へ入金したいと申し出る。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21215-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. I would like to deposit the cash I had set aside for travel into my own account.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21215-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you want to deposit cash set aside for travel into your own account.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21215-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21215-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。キャッシュカードもご用意されていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21215-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: Thank you. Do you also have your cash card ready?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21215-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21215-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 通帳を持っています。カードは家に置いてきました。こちらの窓口でお願いできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21215-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 通帳のみ持参し窓口で入金できるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21215-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: I have my passbook. I left my card at home. Can I do this at this counter?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21215-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese whether you can deposit money at the counter with only your passbook.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21215-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21215-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 窓口で承ります。入金する金額を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21215-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: We can handle it at the counter. How much would you like to deposit?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21215-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21215-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 三万円です。財布の一万円は生活費なので、手元に残します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21215-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 入金三万円と手元に残す生活費を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21215-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: Thirty thousand yen. The ten thousand yen in my wallet is for living expenses, so I will keep it with me.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21215-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: State in Japanese that you will deposit thirty thousand yen and keep the money for living expenses with you.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21215-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21215-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 三万円ですね。こちらの用紙に口座番号と金額をご記入ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21215-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: Thirty thousand yen. Please enter your account number and the amount on this form.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21215-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21215-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 番号は通帳を見て書きます。口座名義は、この欄でよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21215-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 通帳から番号を転記し名義記入欄を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21215-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will copy the number from my passbook. Is this the field for the account holder's name?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21215-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will copy the number from your passbook, and ask which field is for the account holder's name.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21215-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21215-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい、その欄です。ご記入後に、通帳と現金を一緒にお渡しください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21215-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes, that field. When you have finished, please hand me your passbook and cash together.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21215-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21215-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 書けました。通帳と三万円をお渡しします。手続きが終わったら、入金の記録も見たいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21215-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 用紙通帳現金を渡し完了後の記録確認を希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21215-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: I have finished. Here are my passbook and thirty thousand yen. When the transaction is complete, I would also like to check the deposit record.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21215-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Hand over the form, passbook and cash, and say in Japanese that you want to check the record after completion.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21215-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21215-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: お預かりします。記録を確認できるようご案内しますので、少々お待ちください。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21215-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: I will take those. We will show you how to check the record, so please wait a moment. Excuse me.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21215-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21215-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こちらの商品について、何かご希望はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21215-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Do you have any requests regarding this product?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21215-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21215-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: この丸いパンを買いたいです。家に切る道具がないので、薄く切ってもらえるか先に聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21215-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 切具がないため丸パンの薄切対応を購入前に尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21215-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: I would like to buy this round loaf. I have no cutting tools at home, so I want to ask beforehand whether you can slice it thinly.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21215-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese before buying whether the round loaf can be sliced thinly because you have no cutting tools.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21215-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21215-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: この売り場で対応できる加工を確認します。どのような厚さをお考えですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21215-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: I will check what preparation we can provide in this section. What thickness do you have in mind?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21215-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21215-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: サンドイッチにしたいので薄めです。焼き直しではなく、切り分けだけを頼みたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21215-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: サンド用途で薄め希望し再加熱でなく切分と説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21215-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: Thin slices, because I want to make sandwiches. I only want it sliced, not reheated.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21215-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you want thin sandwich slices, and slicing rather than reheating.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21215-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21215-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 可能な方法や必要な時間を、担当に確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21215-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: I will check the possible methods and the time required with the person in charge.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21215-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21215-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: お願いします。買ってから必ず切ってもらえると思わず、先に案内を待ちます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21215-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 会計後当然加工可とせず先に可否時間を待つと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21215-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: Please do. I will wait for the information first, without assuming you will definitely slice it after I buy it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21215-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will wait to hear whether slicing is possible and how long it takes, without assuming it is available after payment.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21215-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21215-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 切る以外の希望もありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21215-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: Do you have any requests besides slicing?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21215-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21215-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 一度に食べないので、持ち帰ってから分けたいです。ただ、小分けの袋まで用意してもらえるかは別に聞きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21215-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 自宅小分け希望だが店の袋準備は別確認と述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21215-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will not eat it all at once, so I want to divide it up after taking it home. However, I will ask separately whether you can provide small bags as well.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21215-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you want to divide it at home but will separately check whether the shop can provide bags.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21215-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21215-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 包装についても、できることを確認してお伝えします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21215-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: I will also check what we can offer for packaging and let you know.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21215-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21215-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。切り方と包装の案内を聞いてから決めます。難しければ、切ってある別の商品も見たいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21215-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 切方包装条件後決定し不可なら既切商品を検討すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21215-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: Thank you. I will decide after hearing about slicing and packaging. If that is difficult, I would also like to look at another product that is already sliced.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21215-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will decide after hearing the slicing and packaging conditions, and consider a presliced product if necessary.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21215-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21215-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 切り分けと包装のご希望を担当へ伝えます。それでは、確認までお待ちください。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21215-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: I will pass your slicing and packaging requests to the person in charge. Please wait while we check. Excuse me.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21215-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21215-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 清掃活動の袋について、お尋ねですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21215-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you asking about the bags for the cleanup activity?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21215-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21215-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。この袋をもらったので、家のごみも入れて持ってくればよいかと思いました。活動の使い方を知りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21215-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 清掃支給袋を家庭ごみ持込用と思ったため用途を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21215-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. Since I received this bag, I thought I could put my household rubbish in it and bring it here. I would like to know how it is used for the activity.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21215-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you thought the cleanup bag was for bringing household rubbish, and ask its purpose.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21215-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21215-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 今日は、公園の清掃で集める物に使う袋としてお渡ししています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21215-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: Today we are providing these bags for things collected while cleaning the park.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21215-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21215-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 分かりました。家のごみは持ってきていません。袋をもらうことと、何でも回収してもらうことは違いますね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21215-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 家庭ごみ未持参で袋支給と無条件回収を区別する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21215-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: I understand. I have not brought any household rubbish. Receiving a bag and having anything collected are different things.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21215-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you have not brought household rubbish, and distinguish bag provision from unconditional collection.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21215-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21215-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 集める物と場所については、活動の案内をご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21215-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please check the activity information for what to collect and where.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21215-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21215-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: お願いします。見つけた物を全部入れる前に、触ってよい物と、職員へ知らせる物を聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21215-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 集める範囲と触れず報告すべき物の案内を希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21215-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: Please help me with that. Before putting everything I find into the bag, I would like to ask what I may touch and what I should report to staff.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21215-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese for guidance on what to collect and what to report without touching.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21215-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21215-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 不明な物は、ご自身で触らず担当へご相談ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21215-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: If you are unsure about an item, do not touch it yourself; consult the person in charge.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21215-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21215-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい。終わった後の袋の置き場所も聞きます。公園の普通のごみ箱へ入れると決めず、活動の案内に従います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21215-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 活動後袋置場を聞き一般ごみ箱へ自己判断しないと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21215-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes. I will also ask where to put the bags afterwards. I will follow the activity instructions instead of deciding to put them in the park's regular bins.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21215-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will ask where bags go after the activity and will not choose ordinary bins on your own.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21215-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21215-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 受付で、その案内をご説明します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21215-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: We will explain those instructions at reception.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21215-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21215-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。家の物は混ぜず、公園で案内された範囲を清掃します。終わったら指定の所へ袋を持っていきます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21215-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 家庭物を混ぜず指定範囲清掃後に袋を案内所へ運ぶと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21215-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: Thank you. I will clean the designated area of the park without mixing in things from home. Afterwards, I will take the bag to the designated place.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21215-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will not mix in household items, will clean the designated area and take the bag to the indicated place afterwards.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21215-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21215-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。それでは、活動の説明をご確認ください。ご協力ありがとうございます。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21215-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Please check the activity instructions. Thank you for your help. Excuse me.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21216-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21216-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お荷物を置いて離れられるご予定ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21216-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you planning to leave your luggage here while you go elsewhere?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21216-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21216-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 飲み物を買いに行きたいです。この席に荷物を置いておけば、戻るまで席も残せるかと思いました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21216-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 飲物購入中荷物を置き席確保したいと希望を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21216-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: I want to buy a drink. I thought leaving my luggage on this seat might keep it for me until I return.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21216-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you want to leave your luggage to save a seat while buying a drink.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21216-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21216-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 荷物はご自身で管理し、お持ちのまま移動してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21216-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please look after your own luggage and take it with you when you move.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21216-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21216-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 分かりました。短い買い物だから大丈夫と決めず、ここに置いたまま離れません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21216-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 短離席を理由に荷物を残さず携行すると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21216-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: I understand. I will not leave it here and walk away on the assumption that a short shopping trip is fine.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21216-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will take your luggage with you rather than leave it because you will be away briefly.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21216-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21216-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 大きなお荷物で、移動が難しいでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21216-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: Is your luggage large and difficult to move?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21216-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21216-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 持てます。ただ、席がなくなるのが気になっていました。荷物を預ける相談と、席を確保する希望は別ですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21216-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 運搬可で預り相談と席保持希望を区別する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21216-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: I can carry it. I was just worried about losing the seat. Asking about luggage storage and wanting to reserve a seat are separate matters.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21216-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you can carry it, and distinguish asking about storage from wanting to keep a seat.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21216-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21216-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 飲み物を買った後は、その時の空いている場所をご利用ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21216-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: After buying your drink, please use whichever space is available then.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21216-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21216-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい。戻ってきても、さっき座った人を自分の席だからと立たせたりはしません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21216-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 帰席時他利用者を退かせず現空席を使うと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21216-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes. When I return, I will not tell someone who has sat down to get up because it is my seat.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21216-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will use an available seat and will not make another user move when you return.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21216-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21216-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: ご同行の方はいらっしゃいますか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21216-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21216-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 一人です。かばんを持って買い物へ行き、戻ったら空いている場所で列車を待ちます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21216-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 単独でかばん携行し購入後空席待機すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21216-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: I am alone. I will take my bag to buy my drink, then wait for the train in an available place when I return.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21216-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you are alone, will carry your bag while shopping and wait in an available seat afterwards.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21216-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21216-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。それでは、お荷物をお忘れなく。お気をつけてご乗車ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21216-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Please do not forget your luggage. Have a safe journey.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21216-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21216-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: このご案内を、どなたかにもお渡しになりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21216-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: Will you be giving this information to someone else as well?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21216-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21216-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 同僚も市役所へ相談したいそうです。私が教えてもらった電話番号を、そのまま渡してよいか知りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21216-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 自己窓口番号を別用件の同僚へ渡せるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21216-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: A colleague apparently wants to consult city hall too. I would like to know whether I can simply give them the phone number I was given.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21216-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese whether you can give your counter's number to a colleague with a different matter.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21216-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21216-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 同僚の方のご用件は、あなたと同じでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21216-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: Is your colleague's enquiry the same as yours?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21216-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21216-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 違うようです。私は講座で、同僚は住まいについてです。市の番号なら全部同じと思っていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21216-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 自己講座と同僚住居で担当同一と誤想していたと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21216-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: It seems different. Mine concerns a course, and my colleague's concerns housing. I thought all city phone numbers were the same.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21216-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you mistakenly thought your course and your colleague's housing enquiry had the same contact.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21216-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21216-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 相談内容によって担当が異なります。総合案内の確認方法をご案内できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21216-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: The department depends on the matter. I can show you how to check with general enquiries.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21216-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21216-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: お願いします。私の担当者へ直接かければ、同僚の問題もすぐ解決するとは伝えません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21216-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 自己担当への直電話で別問題解決とは伝えず総合案内を希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21216-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: Please do. I will not tell my colleague that calling my contact directly will immediately solve their problem too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21216-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese about general enquiries, without claiming a direct call to your contact will solve a different problem.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21216-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21216-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 相手の方が、ご自身の用件を説明できるようにしておくとよいですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21216-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: It would help if your colleague were ready to explain their own enquiry.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21216-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21216-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい。同僚の詳しい事情を私が勝手に聞いて、この窓口へ伝えるのではなく、本人へ相談先の探し方を知らせます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21216-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 同僚詳細を代理収集せず本人へ担当検索法を知らせると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21216-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes. Instead of collecting their detailed circumstances on my own and telling this counter, I will let them know how to find the right contact themselves.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21216-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will tell your colleague how to find the department, rather than collect their details on their behalf.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21216-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21216-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: こちらの案内では、用件から担当を確認できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21216-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: This guide lets you find the department according to the matter.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21216-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21216-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。自分の講座の連絡先と、同僚が担当を探すための案内を分けて渡します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21216-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 自己講座連絡と別用件検索案内を分けて渡すと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21216-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: Thank you. I will give them my course contact separately from the guide for finding the department they need.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21216-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will separately provide your course contact and guidance for finding a contact for a different matter.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21216-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21216-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。それでは、こちらの案内をお持ちください。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21216-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Please take this guide. Excuse me.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21216-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21216-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 診察で聞きたいことを、まとめていらっしゃいますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21216-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: Have you put together what you want to ask during your consultation?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21216-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21216-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。家族からも質問を頼まれました。自分が気になることより、家族の質問ばかり書いてしまいました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21216-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 家族預託質問を優先し自己疑問が抜けたと相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21216-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. My family also asked me to ask some questions. I ended up writing only their questions instead of my own concerns.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21216-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you prioritised your family's questions and left out your own.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21216-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21216-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: ご本人の状態や疑問も、診療担当へお伝えください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21216-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please tell the clinician about your own condition and questions too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21216-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21216-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 分かりました。まず自分が今困っていることを話し、家族から頼まれた質問は、その後で示したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21216-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 自己困り事を先に話し家族質問を後で示す希望を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21216-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: I understand. I would like to explain what is troubling me now first, then show the questions my family asked me to bring.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21216-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you want to discuss your own difficulties first and show your family's questions afterwards.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21216-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21216-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 質問を分けておくと、ご相談しやすいですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21216-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: Separating the questions should make it easier to discuss them.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21216-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21216-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: はい。この丸は自分の疑問で、星は家族が聞きたいことです。家族の言葉を私の症状として話すのは避けます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21216-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 丸自己疑問と星家族質問の記号で症状発言と区別する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21216-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes. These circles mark my questions, and the stars mark what my family wants to ask. I will avoid presenting my family's words as my symptoms.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21216-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that circles mark your questions and stars mark your family's, keeping them distinct from statements about symptoms.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21216-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21216-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: ご家族は今日ご一緒ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21216-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: Is your family here with you today?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21216-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21216-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 今日は来ていません。返事を家族へ伝える場合も、担当が話したことと自分の感想を区別したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21216-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 家族不在で返答伝達時公式説明と自己感想を分けると話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21216-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: They have not come today. When passing the answers on to them, I also want to distinguish what the clinician said from my own impressions.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21216-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that your family is absent and you will distinguish the professional explanation from your own impressions when passing on answers.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21216-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21216-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 説明で分からない部分は、その場で聞き返してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21216-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: If any part of the explanation is unclear, please ask again there and then.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21216-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21216-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: そうします。自分の状態を先に話し、家族の質問も伝えます。答えがなかった所は、確認済みとは書きません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21216-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 未回答は確認済にせず本人状態と家族質問を伝えると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21216-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will. I will describe my condition first and also pass on my family's questions. I will not mark unanswered points as confirmed.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21216-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will explain your condition and your family's questions, without marking unanswered points as confirmed.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21216-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21216-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。それでは、メモをお持ちのまま診察までお待ちください。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21216-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Please keep your notes with you while you wait for your consultation. Excuse me.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21216-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21216-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 画面を見せながら、ご説明されますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21216-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: Will you explain while showing us the screen?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21216-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21216-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。困ったメッセージを見せたいです。ただ、下へ動かすと以前の別の話も出るので、日付を確認してから話したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21216-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: スクロールで別日会話が混じる相談画面の日付を整理したいと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21216-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. I want to show you a troubling message. But scrolling down also reveals an older, different conversation, so I want to check the dates before explaining.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21216-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you want to sort out the dates on the consultation screen because scrolling mixes in conversations from other days.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21216-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21216-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 今回の相談に関係する、やり取りの日時を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21216-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please tell me the date and time of the exchange relevant to this enquiry.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21216-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21216-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 昨日の夜です。この表示からここまでです。上にある先月の話と一つの会話としてまとめないようにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21216-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 昨日夜の表示範囲と先月会話を区別して示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21216-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: Last night. It is from this display to here. I will avoid treating it and last month's conversation above as one conversation.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21216-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Indicate in Japanese the range from last night, distinguishing it from last month's conversation.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21216-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21216-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 元の表示と、前後の内容を確認しながら伺います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21216-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: I will listen while checking the original display and the surrounding context.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21216-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21216-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: お願いします。自分に都合のよい一文だけを切り取るのではなく、昨日のやり取りが分かる範囲を示します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21216-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 有利一文だけでなく当日の前後も提示すると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21216-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: Please do. I will show enough of yesterday's exchange to make it understandable, instead of taking out just one sentence that favours me.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21216-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will show the surrounding exchange from that day, rather than only one favourable sentence.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21216-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21216-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 画面にある相手との関係についても、ご説明ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21216-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please also explain your relationship with the person on the screen.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21216-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21216-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 知人です。登録した名前は私が付けたので、それだけで相手の本名が確認できたとは言えません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21216-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 知人の表示名は自己設定で本名証明でないと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21216-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: They are an acquaintance. I entered the saved name myself, so that alone does not mean their real name has been verified.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21216-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you set your acquaintance's displayed name yourself and it does not prove their real name.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21216-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21216-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 分かっていることと、未確認の点を分けてお話しください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21216-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please distinguish what you know from what has not been confirmed.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21216-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21216-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。昨日の日時とやり取りを先に説明し、以前の会話が関係するならその点も別に伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21216-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 昨日経緯を先説明し旧会話関連は別に説明すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21216-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes. I will first explain yesterday's time and exchange, and explain separately if the older conversation is relevant.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21216-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will explain yesterday's events first and discuss any relevance of older conversations separately.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21216-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21216-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。それでは、元の画面を確認しながらお話を伺います。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21216-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. We will hear your account while checking the original screen. Excuse me.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21216-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21216-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 箱のご準備で、何か気になることがありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21216-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: Is there anything concerning you about preparing the box?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21216-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21216-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 使い回した箱の内側に、家族が書いた電話番号がありました。このまま送ると相手に見えるので、整えてから出したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21216-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 再利用箱内側に家族電話メモが残り発送前に整えたいと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21216-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: There was a phone number my family wrote inside this reused box. The recipient would see it if I sent it like this, so I want to put it right before posting it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21216-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that a family phone number remains inside a reused box and you want to deal with it before sending.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21216-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21216-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: お送りになる箱は、まだ預けていませんね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21216-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: You have not handed over the box you are sending yet, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21216-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21216-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい。外の宛名だけ見ていました。中を開けた人に見える部分も確かめようと思います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21216-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 未差出で外宛先だけでなく受取人に見える内側も点検すると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21216-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: Correct. I had only looked at the address outside. I will also check the parts visible to someone opening it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21216-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that it has not been posted and you will check the inside visible to the recipient as well as the outside address.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21216-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21216-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 内容品を傷めず、包装を整えてから差し出してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21216-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please put the packaging in order without damaging the contents before handing it over.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21216-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21216-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 分かりました。電話番号を隠す材料が、中の品物へ付かないようにしたいです。難しければ別の箱に替えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21216-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 隠す材料が商品へ影響しないようにし不可なら箱変更と伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21216-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: I understand. I want to make sure the material covering the phone number does not stick to the items inside. If that is difficult, I will use another box.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21216-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that the covering material must not affect the goods, and you will change boxes if necessary.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21216-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21216-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 包装が変わった場合は、完成した状態で大きさや重さを確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21216-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: If the packaging changes, we will check its size and weight in its finished state.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21216-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21216-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい。今の箱で聞いた金額のままと決めず、替えた箱で改めて案内を受けます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21216-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 変更後完成外寸重量で費用を再確認すると話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21216-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes. I will ask again about the replacement box, rather than assume the price quoted for this one stays the same.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21216-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will reconfirm the cost using the completed replacement package's external dimensions and weight.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21216-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21216-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 宛先や内容品も、準備後にご自身で見直してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21216-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please also check the destination and contents yourself after preparing it.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21216-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21216-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: そうします。家族のメモを残さない包装にし、品物と宛先を確かめてから持ってきます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21216-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 個人メモを残さず内容宛先を見直して持参すると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21216-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will. I will package it without leaving my family's note, and check the items and address before bringing it here.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21216-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will remove the personal note from the packaging and check the contents and address before bringing it.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21216-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21216-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。それでは、ご準備の後にお越しください。お気をつけてお帰りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21216-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Please come back after preparing it. Take care on your way home.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21216-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21216-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: ご予約についてのお電話ですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21216-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: You are calling about a reservation, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21216-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21216-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。明日一時に窓口相談を予約しましたが、職場の昼休みが短くなりました。時間を変更できますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21216-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 昼休み短縮により翌日一時の銀行相談予約変更を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21216-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. I booked a counter consultation for one tomorrow, but my lunch break at work has been shortened. Could I change the time?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21216-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese to change tomorrow's one o'clock bank consultation because your lunch break has been shortened.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21216-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21216-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: お名前と、ご予約の相談内容を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21216-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please tell me your name and what the reserved consultation is about.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21216-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21216-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: グエンです。銀行のアプリを初めて使うため、最初の操作を教えてもらう予約です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21216-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 氏名とアプリ初回操作相談の予約内容を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21216-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: My name is Nguyen. I am using the bank's app for the first time, and booked a consultation to learn the initial steps.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21216-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: State in Japanese your name and that the reservation concerns the first steps in using the app.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21216-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21216-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 確認できました。明日の三時でしたら、相談枠をご案内できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21216-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: I have found it. We can offer a consultation slot at three tomorrow.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21216-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21216-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 三時は仕事中です。明後日は休みなので、午前の枠があればそちらに移したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21216-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 三時には来店できず翌々日午前枠を希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21216-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: I will be working at three. I have the day after tomorrow off, so I would like to move it to a morning slot then, if there is one.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21216-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you cannot visit at three and would like a morning slot the day after tomorrow.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21216-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21216-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 明後日の十時に空きがあります。ご都合はいかがですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21216-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: There is a slot at ten the day after tomorrow. Would that suit you?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21216-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21216-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 十時でお願いします。スマートフォンも持って行きます。途中で仕事へ戻らなくてよいので、落ち着いて質問できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21216-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 十時を選びスマートフォン持参と時間余裕を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21216-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: Ten, please. I will bring my smartphone too. I will be able to ask questions calmly because I will not have to return to work partway through.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21216-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Choose ten o'clock in Japanese, and mention bringing your smartphone and having enough time.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21216-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21216-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 明後日の十時に変更しました。元の明日一時の予約は取り消します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21216-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: I have changed it to ten the day after tomorrow. I will cancel the original reservation for one tomorrow.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21216-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21216-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。自分の予定表も書き換えます。明日は来店せず、明後日の十時前に受付で名前を伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21216-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 旧予約取消と予定表更新後の来店日時を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21216-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: Thank you. I will change my calendar too. I will not come tomorrow; I will give my name at reception before ten the day after tomorrow.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21216-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm in Japanese the cancellation of the old reservation, updating your calendar and the new visit date and time.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21216-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21216-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 新しい日時でお待ちしております。それでは、当日お気をつけてお越しください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21216-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: We look forward to seeing you at the new time. Please take care on your way here that day.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21216-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21216-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お会計した商品を、どなたかにお渡しですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21216-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you giving the products you have paid for to someone?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21216-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21216-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。妻がまだ売り場にいるので、このパンを渡したいです。買い物中のかごへ入れる前に、どうしたらよいか聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21216-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 会計済パンを売場家族へ渡す前に未会計かごへの扱いを尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21216-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. My wife is still in the shopping area, and I want to give her this bread. Before putting it in her shopping basket, I would like to ask what I should do.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21216-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese how to handle paid bread before giving it to family in the shopping area and putting it into an unpaid basket.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21216-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21216-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 会計済みの商品と、これから買う商品は区別してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21216-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please keep products already paid for separate from those you are going to buy.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21216-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21216-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 分かりました。このレシートはあります。妻の未会計の商品に混ぜて、もう一度払うことは避けたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21216-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 自己レシートありで再会計混入を避けたいと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21216-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: I understand. I have this receipt. I want to avoid mixing it with my wife's unpaid items and paying for it again.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21216-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you have your receipt and want to avoid mixing it into items to be paid for again.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21216-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21216-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: ご家族にも、会計した商品だとお伝えください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21216-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please tell your family member that the product has been paid for too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21216-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21216-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: はい。袋とレシートを一緒に渡します。パンだけかごへ入れて、何も言わずに帰るのはやめます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21216-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 袋記録と共に渡し会計済を口頭共有すると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21216-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes. I will give her the bag and receipt together. I will not just put the bread in the basket and leave without saying anything.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21216-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will hand over the bag and receipt and verbally explain that it is paid for.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21216-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21216-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: ほかに、ご自身の購入した物はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21216-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: Are there any other items you bought yourself?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21216-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21216-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: ほかは私が持ち帰ります。レシートに両方載っているので、妻へ渡す品物がどれかも説明します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21216-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 同レシート他品は自己持帰なので譲渡品を特定すると話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21216-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will take the others home myself. Both are on the receipt, so I will also explain which item I am giving my wife.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21216-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese which item you are handing over, since other items on the same receipt will go home with you.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21216-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21216-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: お店で確認が必要になったら、商品とレシートをお見せください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21216-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: If the shop needs to check, please show the products and receipt.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21216-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21216-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: そうします。妻にはこのパンだけを渡し、会計済みと伝えて別に持ってもらいます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21216-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: パンのみ家族へ渡し購入済として別携行してもらうと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21216-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will. I will give my wife only this bread, tell her it is paid for and ask her to carry it separately.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21216-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will give your family only the bread and ask them to carry it separately as an already purchased item.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21216-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21216-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。それでは、お忘れ物なくお持ちください。ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21216-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Please take everything with you. Thank you for shopping with us.
